verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents account- or company-level analysis of trends, funnels, or retention. The closest items don't qualify: feature flags can roll out 'by group', which is a targeting control rather than analytics; SQL GROUP BY and warehouse joins with Salesforce or HubSpot are developer building blocks; and an MCP tool category named 'Customer analytics' has no described account-level scope. None of these show insights aggregated by company rather than by user, so the verdict stays at none.
